sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案・議決結果の一覧

name: 医療費助成の事務で個人番号の利用を拡大
summary: 現在、子どもと妊娠高血圧症候群等の医療費助成は、個人番号を利用できる事務として条例に定められていません。この議案では、この2つの事務を追加します。また、大気汚染に関する医療費助成を含む3つの事務で、生活保護や健康保険などの情報を利用できるようにします。
changes: 子どもの医療費助成の事務で個人番号を利用できるようにする
妊娠高血圧症候群等の医療費助成の事務で個人番号を利用できるようにする
この2つと大気汚染に関する医療費助成の事務で、生活保護や健康保険などの情報を利用できるようにする
児童手当の支給事務で、子どもの医療費助成の情報を利用できるようにする
who: 子どもの医療費助成を利用する人
妊娠高血圧症候群等の医療費助成を利用する人
大気汚染による健康障害の医療費助成を利用する人
why: 子どもと妊娠高血圧症候群等の医療費助成では保険の資格を示す書類の提出を不要にし、大気汚染に関する助成ではマイナ保険証だけで資格を確認できるようにするためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Expands use of individual numbers in medical assistance procedures
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Suginami City Ordinance on the Use of Individual Numbers and the Provision of Specific Personal Information
en.summary: Currently, medical expense assistance for children and for pregnancy-induced hypertension syndrome, etc., is not listed in the ordinance as administrative work in which individual numbers may be used. This bill adds these two types of work. It also allows information such as public assistance and health insurance information to be used in three types of work, including medical expense assistance related to air pollution.
changes: Allow individual numbers to be used for administrative work on medical expense assistance for children
Allow individual numbers to be used for administrative work on medical expense assistance for pregnancy-induced hypertension syndrome, etc.
Allow information such as public assistance and health insurance information to be used in these two types of work and in work on medical expense assistance related to air pollution
Allow information on medical expense assistance for children to be used in work on child allowance payments
who: People receiving medical expense assistance for children
People receiving medical expense assistance for pregnancy-induced hypertension syndrome, etc.
People receiving medical expense assistance for health problems caused by air pollution
en.why: Suginami City says the changes will make it unnecessary to submit documents proving insurance eligibility for assistance for children and for pregnancy-induced hypertension syndrome, etc., and will allow eligibility for air pollution-related assistance to be confirmed using only a My Number health insurance card.
